name: test-audit
description: Gate every new or changed mdk test, prune existing ones and fill coverage gaps: name the contract and the regression a test catches, give each contract one owner at the cheapest layer that runs the real production code, reject duplicate or implementation-coupled proof, and retire test-only production seams. Use when writing, changing, reviewing or deleting tests, or when asked to audit, trim, consolidate, speed up or add missing tests. For a whole crate or subsystem, also read CAMPAIGN.md.
